description: Tidegap: at session start, name the tasks this session queued that finished unread (ids, status, how they ran; never their text), and print one line for other unread tasks (silent when nothing is unread or the tidegap CLI is not installed; falls back to the 0.17 ebb command). At session start and end, keep ~/.tidegap/sessions/claude-<pid>.json current, so a task queued from this session knows which session asked for it. When a prompt asks for recurring work ("every night", "set up a cron", "каждый день"), add one context line that points the agent at Tidegap jobs instead of cron. Before a Bash call that edits a crontab, loads a launchd agent, enables a systemd user unit or authors a Tidegap command job, ask the user first (never deny).

hooks.command: input=$(cat); if command -v tidegap >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$input" | tidegap queue list --unread --hook --hook-input - 2>/dev/null || tidegap queue list --unread --hook 2>/dev/null; elif command -v ebb >/dev/null 2>&1; then ebb queue list --unread --hook 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0
